gap: On mobile (390px) the comparison table scrolls horizontally and the Growth column, the one marked MOST POPULAR, is sliced in half at the viewport edge: its badge renders as 'G', its CTA as 'Sel', its value cell as 'Up'. A half-cut recommended plan reads as a broken page. Either restructure the mobile comparison as a per-plan stacked list (one plan block at a time, feature rows underneath), or make the sticky feature-label column narrower and snap-scroll one full plan column into view at a time so no column is ever rendered part-width.
